description: Gabonese Air Force liaison aircraft, construction number 101M, coded preserved within the military area on the seaward side of Libreville Léon-Mba. Not independently corroborated and not resolvable from satellite: the only Esri coverage of this block is 15 April 2017 at 0.5 m, at which scale a Broussard spans about eleven pixels. Recorded on the strength of the source's explicit preserved code and its specific construction number. Note the near-identical Chadian airframe TT-KAB, construction number 203M, also preserved - a French supply pattern to former AEF air arms, not a duplicate record.

Gabonese Air Force Bandeirante, construction number 110360, coded preserved; the location entry was created on 20 May 2025 and carries a contributor comment quoting the registration and construction number together, which indicates a first-hand sighting rather than a copied listing. Single-sourced. Satellite confirmation not possible - the only Esri coverage here is from April 2017 and predates the report.
